content: Hikɨ mɨpaɨta katiniwarutahɨawe: —Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, hipatɨ 'ena memu'uwa mepɨkakwini mexi mekanenieriwawe kemɨtiyɨni kepauka Kakaɨyari munuani tɨrɨkaɨyemekɨ ti'aitatɨ.
Ketsutsi yɨkɨ 'anetɨ kemɨratɨa
Hikɨ 'ataxewime tukari 'anukayaku Ketsutsi kaniwarewitɨni Pekuru, Kakuwu meta Wani, yemuri 'amanutitewitsie yuhɨkɨame. Hikɨ mana wahɨxie yɨkɨ 'anetɨ kanayani.
Kemarieya xawatɨtɨ kanayani kwi tuxatɨ 'ɨwi hepaɨ, kwiepa muxuawe tituriyame mɨpaɨ 'aneme meyeitɨani pɨkayɨwe.
Mana 'Eriyaxi meta Muitsexi mekaniuyuhekɨata, mɨkɨ Ketsutsi hamatɨa mekatenikuxatakaitɨni.

Hikɨ Pekuru mɨpaɨ Ketsutsi katiniutahɨawe: —Ti'ɨkitame 'aku, 'aixɨa kani'aneni 'ena temu'uwakɨ. Kamɨtsɨ xamaru tepɨtiwewieni haikame, 'ahetsiemieme xeime, Muitsexi hetsiemieme xeime meta 'Eriyaxi hetsiemieme xeime.
'Atsipɨkatiyumaiwekai kemɨtayɨni, yunaitɨ waɨkawa memumamakaikɨ.
Hikɨ yapauka haiwitɨri kaniwaranukanani, hikɨ mɨkɨ haiwitɨritsata xewitɨ kanetaniuni mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «'Ikɨ kanineniwetɨni neminaki'erie. Xekene'enieka».
Yapauka, mehanieretɨkɨneka naitsarie, xeime mepɨka'uxei wa'aurie 'uweme, Ketsutsi xeikɨa mekaniuxeiya.
Hikɨ yemuritsie me'akahutɨ, Ketsutsi kaniwaruhɨritɨani nixeime memɨkatehaxaxatɨwanikɨ kememɨte'unenierixɨ, kepaukake Yuri Tewi mɨkite watsata manukukeni.
Kemainekai yamepɨtekakɨ mepɨkate'utaxa, peru mɨkɨ niuki mekanixɨatɨakaitɨni tita mɨtixatakai «mɨkite watsata manukukeni».
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenita'iwawiya: —¿Mɨkɨ 'inɨarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitamete titayari mɨpaɨ mete'utiyuane kename heuyewetse 'Eriyaxi meri munuani?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Kaniyuritɨni. 'Eriyaxi meri kaninuamɨkɨ, 'aixɨa mitiyurieni tinaime. ¿Matsi kere'uxa Yuri Tewi hepaɨtsita, kemɨreuyewetse waɨkawa mɨtikwinekɨ mɨxani'eriwanikɨ?
Peru ne mɨpaɨ nepɨxekɨhɨawe, 'Eriyaxi 'ari kaninuani, meta kemɨtiwanakekai yamepiyuri, mɨpaɨ kemɨre'uxa hepaɨtsitana.
Ketsutsi 'aixɨa reu'eriekame temaikɨ kemɨrayeitɨa kakaɨyari 'axamɨ'ane 'iwiyakaku
Merikɨtsɨ kepauka memu'axɨa hipatɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mematitekaitsie, yumɨireme teɨteri mekaniwaruxeiya wa'aurie meta 'inɨarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitametetɨkai niuki mexɨatɨakame wahamatɨa.
Hikɨ yapauka teɨteri me'ixeiyaka mekaniuhɨxiyani meta hepana mekaniutinautsa mekanitawaɨritɨani.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya mɨkɨ 'inɨarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitametetɨkai: —¿Titakɨ niuki xetexɨatɨakai wahamatɨa?
Xewitɨ tewi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Neuxei ti'ɨkitame, neniwe 'uki nepɨmatsi'atɨiri, kakaɨyari 'axamɨ'ane pinɨ'ɨ pɨka'ipitɨa mɨtaniunikɨ.

Kepauka mikuwiwiya, petihɨpa. Kwaimuxari putahewa, yutametekɨ pɨtiutakewe meta naranitɨ payeika. Ne nekaniwarutawawirieni teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete 'ahetsɨa miemete 'aixɨa reu'eriekame memayeitɨanikɨ, peru mepɨka'uyɨwekaxɨa.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Xeme hikɨ xemɨmiemete yuri xepɨkate'erie. ¿Kepaɨmexɨa peuyewetse 'akuxi xehamatɨa nemuyeikani? ¿Kepaɨmexɨa 'akuxi nepɨtixenewirieka? Xekenawitɨki mɨkɨ temaikɨ.
Hikɨ mekani'atɨirieni. Mɨkɨ kakaɨyari 'axamɨ'ane Ketsutsi 'uxeiyaka, yapauka temaikɨ kaniutanɨni kwiepa kanikahɨani meta kanikurupenekaitɨni 'atakwaimuxatɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'iwawiya paapaya: —¿Kepaɨmexɨari mɨyapɨ'ane? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Nunutsiyari paitɨ.
Heiwa taipa kaneihɨpani meta hapa 'imienike. 'Ekɨ xɨka peyɨweni tixaɨtɨ pemɨtiyurieni, ketaneutinenimayata meta ketaneuparewi.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —¿Ketitayari peraine, xɨka neyɨweni? Kemɨ'ane yuri mɨti'erie, hetsiena mieme naitɨ pɨtiyɨwe.
Hikɨ temaikɨ paapaya mɨpaɨ katiniuhiwa: —Huu yuri nepɨti'erie. Keneneuparewi xɨka 'etsiwa xeikɨa yuri neti'erieka.

Ketsutsi meyumɨireme teɨteri waruxeiyaka 'ame'anautsaxɨaximeme hepana meyukuxeɨrienike, 'iyari 'axamɨ'ane kaniutatieni, mɨpaɨ tikɨhɨawetɨ: —Keneu'ena 'iyari 'axamɨ'ane, pemɨka'ipitɨa mɨtaniunikɨ meta meu'enanikɨ, ne nekameninɨ'aka pemixɨnakɨ meta tawarita pemɨka'ikuwiwiyanikɨ.
'Iyari 'axamɨ'ane, kaniutahiwa meta karima hau'erietɨ kanetihɨani kanitayɨyɨakatsitɨani. Mɨki hepaɨ 'anetɨ kanayani temaikɨ, 'ayumieme 'etsiwatɨkaku yunaitɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: «Kaniumɨniri».
Peru Ketsutsi temaikɨ mamaya 'uwiyaka kanenukuhana, hikɨ temaikɨ 'akaniutakeni.
Hikɨ kiita heutahaku, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama yɨhɨkɨate mɨpaɨ mekatenita'iwawiya: —¿Titayari tame teteyutatexi te'eyenɨ'anike?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Yunenewietɨ xeikɨa kaniyɨweni meyenɨ'anikɨ 'ipaɨ 'aneme.
Hikɨ mana mekanekɨne, Karereya kwieyaritsie mekaniuyekɨne. Pɨka'inakekai xewitɨ mɨtitamarienikɨ,

teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete katiniwa'ɨkitɨakaitɨni. Mɨpaɨ katiniwakɨhɨawekaitɨni: «Yuri Tewi kenemɨtihɨkɨ, nekaniyetuiyamɨkɨ teɨteri wahetsɨa. Mɨkɨ mekanenimiekuni, nemierieme hairieka tukari 'anukayayu nekananukukemɨkɨ».
Peru mɨkɨ 'ikɨ niuki mepɨkahetimaiwawekai, meta mekanimamakaitɨni me'ita'iwawiyake.
Kemɨ'ane matsi mɨmariwe
Merikɨtsɨ Kaperunaume mekaneta'axɨani. Kiita meheutahaxɨaku mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya: —¿Titakɨ niuki xetehexɨatɨakai huyeta?
Mɨkɨ kayuwatɨ xeikɨa mekaniumakaitɨni, niuki memɨxɨatɨakaikɨ huyeta kemɨ'ane mɨkɨ matsi waɨkawa meuyewekai.

Hikɨ 'a'ayerɨka, tamamata heimana yuhutame waruta'inieka yu'aurie, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xewitɨ xɨka mexɨakame 'ayeimɨkɨni, kaneuyeweka yunaime waparewiwame mayuyeitɨanikɨ 'imatɨreme mayuyeitɨanikɨ.
Hikɨ nunutsi 'ahanaka wahixɨapa kanitakeni. Meta 'itituka mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe:
—Kemɨ'ane mitanaki'erieni xeime 'ikɨ tɨɨri nehetsɨa miemekɨ, kemɨ'ane mɨnetsitanaki'erieni, nexeikɨa pɨkanetsitanaki'erieni, matsi kemɨ'ane mɨnetsiheyenɨ'a kanitanaki'eriemɨkɨta.
Kemɨ'ane mɨkatatsi'aye'unie mɨkɨ tahetsie katiniwiyani
Wani mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ti'ɨkitame, xeime tahetsie mɨkatiwiya tekanexeiya warayenɨ'awame kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene, 'ahetsɨa waniu miemetɨtɨ. Mɨkɨ tahetsie mɨkatiwiyakɨ, 'ayumieme tepɨkaheipitɨa.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Xepɨkaheiku'imaiyani. Tewi xɨka tɨrɨkaɨyemekɨ 'inɨari tiyurieneni, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ kename nehetsɨa mieme, pɨkayɨwe nehepaɨtsita 'axamainenikɨ.
Kemɨ'ane mɨkatatsi'aye'unie, tahetsie katiniwiyani.
Kemɨ'ane xeitekɨxiyari mɨxeharitɨani Kɨritsitu hetsɨa miemete xemɨhɨkɨkɨ, mɨkɨ yu'iwarika pɨkareuyehɨani pɨtipitɨarieni.
Titakɨ mɨtitiketamɨre
»Peru, kemɨ'ane yu'iwa 'axamɨyurieni 'ikɨ tɨɨri yuri memɨte'erie nehetsie, 'aixɨa kaniyɨmɨkɨ matsi matá mahete xɨka 'akatɨtɨarienike kɨipieyatsie meta xɨka haramaratsie heukahɨiyanike.
Xɨka 'amamakɨ 'axapetiyurieneni, kenawiteki. 'Aixɨa kaniyɨmɨkɨ matsi xɨka peheutahani tukari maxuawetsie pemamapurutɨ, keyuri hutame mamayari pehexeiyatɨ yuheyemekɨ mɨta'atsie xɨka peheukahɨiyani.
Mana kwitsi mɨwakɨme pɨkamɨni tai pɨkatɨweni.
Xɨka 'a'ɨkakɨ 'axapetiyurieneni, kenawiteki. Matsi 'aixɨa pɨyɨni xɨka pe'ɨkapurutɨ peheutahani tukari maxuawetsie, keyuri hutame 'ɨkate pehexeiyatɨ tai yuheyemekɨ mɨta'atsie xɨka peheukahɨiyani.
Mana kwitsi mɨwakɨme pɨkamɨni tai pɨkatɨweni.
Meta, xɨka 'ahɨxikɨ 'axapetiyurieneni, keniwayetu'i. Matsi 'aixɨa kaniyɨmɨkɨ tapa xeikɨa peheunieretɨ pemeutahanikɨ Kakaɨyari mɨra'aitatsie, keyuri hutame hɨxite pehexeiyatɨ taipa peheukahɨiyanikɨ.
Mana
Yunaitɨ mekani'itiyakuni taikɨ, naitɨ mawari kemɨti'itiwa 'unakɨ.
»'Una 'aixɨa kani'aneni, peru xɨka 'una hamuritɨ 'ayani, ¿titakɨ ha'utsiwime xeteheyeitɨanikeyu 'una? 'Una xekenexeiyani yuhetsie 'aixɨa xeteyuxeiyatɨ».
